name: Eraliwyr

facts.text: Eraliwyr: level 35, the small-folk body of the spraggons (model 112, size 66, the size of a spraggonote), at about 31,600/27,000 at the northern crossing, under 500 from Spriggit, among spraggonix and an earth sprite; no faction; respawn 300 seconds; a plain spawn (package ClassicQuest).

Viraniel's Plague (Viraniel, Tir na Nog): Dwerrania's potion turns Viraniel into a skeleton warrior who flies off; Dwerrania gives a jade jar; 'Find the alchemist Eraliwyr hidden deep in the Spraggon Den (talk to him; he attacks) and kill him.'; then a sand worm's tongue (Bog of Cullen beach), a greater zephyr's wind (east of Tir Urphost) and a luch catcher's bladder (south-southwest of Treibh Caillte); 'Check on Viraniel.'

story:
Eraliwyr came into the Spraggon Den years ago to work where nobody would watch him, and the spraggons let him stay because he is near enough their own kind to argue with: small and knobbled and grey, one of the small folk of the hills, though no spraggon will say he is one of them and he has never said he is not. He keeps a lamp and a bench at the northern crossing beside Spriggit, and the den says the cold that crackles off Spriggit came off that bench.

Tir na Nog tells the rest. Viraniel, a woman of the druid grove, took a cup from him once in the lower town, for a cough, and sickened of something no draught of the grove would touch. When Dwerrania the herb-woman gave her the best the grove could make, the flesh went off her bones and she went over the wall a skeleton, armed, on the wind. Dwerrania sends the young to the den with a jade jar to carry the cure's makings home in, and they come back by way of the Cullen strand, the cliff-top above Tir Urphost and the luch country south of Treibh Caillte, and in the end Viraniel comes back too, and is herself, more or less.

The druids keep the jar. Eraliwyr talks to those who find him, politely, about the weather in the den and the price of jade, right up until he does not.
legend: Eraliwyr (35) hides at the northern crossing of the Spraggon Den (about 31.6k/27.0k), under 500 from Spriggit (26) and among spraggonix (24-29). He is the kill step of Viraniel's Plague (Viraniel in Tir na Nog, Dwerrania in the druid grove): the quest says talk to him, then he attacks. A 35 in a 20s den: a group of mid 30s or a strong 40 solo. Clear Spriggit first; his root is the danger. Plain spawn, no script, 5-minute respawn.
